Context: 2. Group Insurance Scheme, 1980

## 2. Group Insurance Scheme, 1980  
[ Swamy's -  
Group Insurance Scheme ]  
1. Scope.The Scheme, which is compulsory to all the Central Government employees, (including Departmental Canteen employees)  
provides at a low cost and on contributory and self-financing basis, the twin benefits of an insurance cover to help their families in the event of death in service and a lumpsum payment to augment their resources on retirement. - Para. 2.
